journal.attuned.title: Attunement Journal
journal.attuned.screen.title: Attunement Codex
journal.attuned.screen.subtitle: Foci, pacts, altar craft
journal.attuned.line1: Foci work only while equipped and inside your capacity.
journal.attuned.line2: Slot order is priority: higher slots wake first when capacity is tight.
journal.attuned.line3: Holy beats Fury, Fury beats Bastion, Bastion beats Zephyr, and Zephyr beats Holy.
journal.attuned.line4: Mixing active affinities creates Discord: more damage dealt and taken.
journal.attuned.line5: Pacts wake at three Foci. Apex wakes near full capacity through commitment, Discord, or a neutral path.
journal.attuned.line6: Bind shards at an Attunement Altar, and craft four fragments into one shard.
journal.attuned.line7: The Unseen reward stillness, shadows, and openings rather than raw force.
journal.attuned.line8: Foci and shard fragments are found through vanilla loot, including Lootr-style chests.
journal.attuned.page1:
Attunement Journal

Equip Foci in the side slots of your inventory.

A Focus only works while it is awake inside your capacity.
journal.attuned.page2:
Priority

Higher Focus slots wake first.

If your total cost is too high, lower slots go dormant before higher slots.
journal.attuned.page3:
Capacity

Capacity is your build budget.

Bind Attunement Shards at an Altar to raise it, up to the server's cap.
journal.attuned.page4:
Affinities

Holy beats Fury.
Fury beats Bastion.
Bastion beats Zephyr.
Zephyr beats Holy.

Neutral Foci fit any build.
journal.attuned.page5:
Discord

Using two or more active affinities creates Discord.

You deal more damage, but you also take more damage.
journal.attuned.page6:
Pacts

Three active Foci of one affinity can awaken a Pact.

Pacts reward committing to a lane instead of wearing every trick at once.
journal.attuned.page7:
Apex

Four active Foci near full capacity can reach Apex.

Committed lanes wake Execute, Unyielding, Untouchable, or Judgment. Build combat resonance to arm them.
journal.attuned.page8:
Shards and Altars

Four Shard Fragments craft into one Attunement Shard.

Place a shard in the Altar and press Bind.
journal.attuned.page9:
The Unseen

These Foci favor quiet movement, smoke, veils, and ambush openings.

They are a faction, not a fourth affinity.
journal.attuned.page10:
Finding Foci

Attuned adds Foci and shard fragments to vanilla loot: structures, fishing treasure, archaeology, and trial rewards.

Lootr chests use the same chest tables.
journal.attuned.page11:
First Builds

At capacity 4, keep it plain.

Swift and Leap make a travel kit. Harvest and Nightgaze make a calm work kit. Vital can stand alone.
journal.attuned.page12:
Capacity 6

Try Iron and Emberward for a Bastion guard.

Edge and Frenzy favor Fury raids.

Swift, Leap, and Softstep suit Zephyr roads.
journal.attuned.page13:
Adjusting

If a Focus sleeps, move it to a higher slot or lower the cost.

Bind shards for more capacity. Neutral Foci are easiest to fit.
journal.attuned.page14:
Altar Memory

Altars bind shards and return anything left inside when closed.

Their glow remembers the last bound affinity. Candles and amethyst only change the ritual's look.
journal.attuned.page15:
Pyresworn Pact

Three active Fury Foci awaken Pyresworn.

Melee hits can ignite foes. Try Edge, Frenzy, and another Fury Focus.
journal.attuned.page16:
Stoneheart Pact

Three active Bastion Foci awaken Stoneheart.

Incoming damage is dulled. Try Iron, Emberward, and Vital.
journal.attuned.page17:
Windrunner Pact

Three active Zephyr Foci awaken Windrunner.

You sprint faster and step over short rises. Try Swift, Leap, and Softstep.
journal.attuned.page29:
Radiant Covenant

Three active Holy Foci awaken Radiant Covenant.

Charged melee hits reveal visible threats. Against undead, the wound deepens only slightly.
journal.attuned.page18:
Untethered Pact

One active Focus from every affinity awakens Untethered.

You hit affinity-bearing foes harder, but the pattern is harder to hold.
journal.attuned.page19:
Discord

Discord is a risky stance, not a mistake.

Mixed affinities raise damage dealt and taken. Use it for short aggressive fights, then settle into a Pact when you want stability.
journal.attuned.page30:
Maelstrom Apex

Run every affinity at once near full capacity to wake Maelstrom.

At resonance, direct hits bite harder and scramble struck affinity foes.
journal.attuned.page31:
Stillpoint Apex

Run four or more neutral Foci near full capacity to wake Stillpoint.

At resonance, affinity pressure is denied and combat can pulse Absorption.
journal.attuned.page20:
The Altar of Reweaving

Some altars do not deepen the soul's room.

They turn an old pattern until it catches the light differently.
journal.attuned.page21:
What Reweaving Is Not

Reweaving does not make a Focus louder, stronger, or freer.

It changes the way a bound pattern is remembered.
journal.attuned.page22:
Altar Memory

Every altar keeps a trace of what was last bound there.

Reweaving listens to that trace before it answers.
journal.attuned.page23:
The Radiant

The Radiant keep vows in light.

They believe power is safest when named, witnessed, and remembered.
journal.attuned.page24:
The Unseen

The Unseen keep masks and hidden roads.

They believe power is safest when no one can claim or own it.
journal.attuned.page25:
Witness and Veil

Radiant and Unseen oppose each other like lantern and shadow.

Both exist to keep attunement from becoming careless.
journal.attuned.page26:
The Seafarers

The Seafarers carry fragments, journals, and half-remembered routes from shore to shore.

They trade in guidance, not conquest.
journal.attuned.page27:
Tide Records

A Seafarer's best map is return.

Where a wreck sank. Where a bell was heard. Where a shard washed clean.
journal.attuned.page32:
The Offshore

After harbor lights fail, Offshore crews salvage wrecks and bargain with storms. Harpoon Focus calls a temporary Ocean Relic Trident for deep-water work. It cannot be crafted.
journal.attuned.page33:
The Revenant

The Revenant carry unfinished endings: debts, names, last roads, and grave-cold vows.

Their Foci answer death without making death cheap.
journal.attuned.page28:
Reading the HUD

The marks near your hand are not commands from the altar.

They are the shape your active Foci make when the world pushes back.

item.attuned.hollowstep_focus.effect: Press the Focus Ability key to phase 5 blocks forward through entities, not walls.
item.attuned.last_rites_focus.lore2: Some endings wash the living too.
item.attuned.last_rites_focus.effect: Kills against hostile foes can cleanse poison, wither, slowness, or fire from you.
item.attuned.bonechill_focus.lore: Cold enough to make old bones answer.
item.attuned.bonechill_focus.effect: Undead you strike, and hostile foes that strike you, are briefly slowed.
item.attuned.attunement_altar.lore: Worked stone, and a hollow that remembers.
item.attuned.attunement_altar.lore2: What you bind here, the soul keeps.
item.attuned.attunement_altar.effect: Bind Attunement Shards at the Altar to raise your capacity.
item.attuned.altar_of_reweaving.lore: Worked deepslate, amethyst dust, and the patience to remember differently.
item.attuned.altar_of_reweaving.lore2: Its basin turns old patterns until they catch another light.
item.attuned.altar_of_reweaving.effect: Consumes three Foci and a Shard Fragment to reweave one new Focus.
onboarding.attuned.first_shard.detail: Bring it to an Attunement Altar to raise your capacity.
onboarding.attuned.first_fragment.found: You found an Attunement Shard Fragment.
onboarding.attuned.first_fragment.detail: Collect four, then craft them into a full shard.
onboarding.attuned.altar_sight: An Altar waits. Right-click empty-handed to open it, or with a shard to bind directly.
onboarding.attuned.first_dormant.found: Dormant Foci stay equipped but inactive.
onboarding.attuned.first_dormant.detail: Move them higher, bind shards, or hover for details.
